answer_1.quote: We explored accelerating text communication by abbreviated sentence input.
answer_1.outputs: Expanded sentences from abbreviated input (e.g., missing spaces and mid-word vowels)

answer_2.quote: We measured accuracy using character error rate (CER). CER is the number of insertions, substitutions, and deletions required to transform the expanded text into the original text...

answer_4.quote: We recruited 28 Amazon Mechanical Turk workers. The study took 30-40 minutes. Workers were paid $10.
answer_4.guideline: Workers typed 26 phrases in each condition. The first two were practice phrases which we did not analyze. Workers wrote phrases written by people with ALS for voice banking purposes.
